'''Kaogar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], acting as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in a gang led by a [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] called the [[Locust]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaogar appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an enemy on Republic version of Taris.<ref name="SWTOR" />
